basic_info.description: Welcome to 140 Marview Way - a fully detached, newly renovated home nestled in the serene Midtown Terrace neighborhood near Twin Peaks. Enjoy captivating views of the Pacific Ocean and Sutro Tower from this stylishly modern home. The open floor plan features a spacious great room with an open kitchen centered around a large island, creating a perfect flow for both entertaining and everyday living. The upper level offers 2BD/2BA, including a master en-suite with a luxe spa-like bath with steam shower and a private balcony overlooking the peaceful surroundings. A sleek open staircase with glass railings leads to the lower level, where you'll find an additional 2BD/2BA and a large family room with a wet bar. This level opens directly to a tranquil backyard, designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living and relaxation. This home is also equipped with hot water radiant floor heating throughout. Located in a hidden gem of a neighborhood surrounded by nature, this home offers the perfect blend of tranquility and city convenience, with nearby schools and easy access to public transportation. Embrace peaceful, modern living in the heart of the city. Don't miss out this great opportunity!
